description: A synthetic dataset of 10,000 Agile Scrum project reports with deterministically-computed effort and cost labels. Designed for training NLP + regression deep-learning models for software cost estimation.
generation_logic: Each project's cost is derived from: final_effort = (base_effort + story_effort) × complexity_multiplier × tech_multiplier × volatility_multiplier. final_cost = final_effort × cost_per_hour (with ±5% noise). base_effort = team_size × duration_months × 160. story_effort = total_user_stories × avg_story_points × 4.
